bird_socket.description: Path to the BIRD control socket (typically /var/run/bird/bird.ctl or /var/run/bird/bird6.ctl for IPv6)

exporter_address.description: Network address the exporter listens on (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only)

exporter_port.description: Port number the exporter exposes metrics on

metrics_protocols.description: Collect metrics about BIRD routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, etc.)

metrics_routes.description: Collect metrics about route tables (prefixes, next hops)

metrics_kernel.description: Collect metrics about the kernel routing table

metrics_export_tables.description: Collect metrics about route export tables

log_level.description: Verbosity of exporter logs (debug, info, warn, error)

bird_instances.description: List of additional BIRD socket paths to monitor (e.g., for multi-instance deployments)

items.description: Path to a BIRD control socket

connect_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for establishing connection to BIRD socket
